runtime.install_behavior: npx downloads the pinned runtime into npm's local cache and starts it; no global SuperCollab install or management CLI is required

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.access: Claude authentication and model access are managed separately from SuperCollab.
agents.summary: Claude Code launches SuperCollab as a project-local MCP process with its normal trust and tool-approval controls.

setups.label: Claude Code command
setups.target: Run from the intended project folder
setups.value: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local supercollab -- npx -y @supercollab/mcp@0.7.0-alpha.9

agents.next_step: Start a fresh Claude Code session, open /mcp, and ask Claude to check SuperCollab status.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.access: Gemini authentication and model access are managed separately from SuperCollab.
agents.summary: Gemini CLI launches a project-scoped local MCP server and keeps its own trust and tool controls in charge.

setups.label: Gemini CLI command
setups.target: Run from the intended project folder
setups.value: gemini mcp add --scope project supercollab npx -y @supercollab/mcp@0.7.0-alpha.9

agents.next_step: Start a fresh Gemini CLI session, open /mcp, and ask Gemini to check SuperCollab status.
